Body.Content:
Microsoft Contact Center Intelligence uses consumption-based billing for AI-powered interactions. Usage generated by voice and digital agents is metered and billed based on actual consumption, including AI model processing, tool usage, orchestration, and related AI services. Usage is attributed to your organization and charged through your configured billing enrollment, enabling transparent cost tracking and pay-for-what-you-use pricing. Authorized users can view usage details, monitor consumption trends, and download reports for cost management and analysis.

GA date: November CY2026

Preview date: October CY2026
